create_discounted_reward_instance: create a DiscountedReward instance with a configurable discount factor defaulting to 0.99
set_initial_rewards: set initial rewards tensor R and feed the mean to stats init_reward
feed_batch_rewards: feed a batch with immediate rewards and terminal signals to compute discounted accumulated rewards
compute_discounted_accumulated_reward: compute discounted accumulated reward by multiplying previous reward by discount factor and adding immediate reward
review_terminal_reset_logic: review the DiscountedReward feed method that resets reward backpropagation on terminal signals
